planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.
Create a new free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimension
Create a new value for one of the free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimensions

rules: ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex auto-generates VAT and credit postings.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

payload.headline: Voucher created successfully after 2 failed attempts due to vatType auto-generation confusion
what_went_wrong: First POST /ledger/voucher failed: agent assumed Tripletex would auto-generate VAT/credit postings from a single debit line with vatType, but this requires manual balancing.
Second POST /ledger/voucher failed: agent tried voucherType:{id:5} to enable auto-generation, but the voucherType ID was invalid, wasting a call.
No scoring data returned (0/0 checks), making it impossible to confirm correctness of account selection (6540 Inventar vs. a dedicated office chair account) or VAT treatment.
what_worked: Correct VAT math: 6750 gross / 1.25 = 5400 net, 1350 VAT, and proper exclusion of Kaffemøte line.
Department, supplier, and account lookups all succeeded on first attempt with correct IDs used in final voucher.
what_to_try_next: Always use fully manual 3-line voucher postings (expense debit, VAT debit, AP credit) from the start instead of relying on Tripletex auto-generation, to avoid wasted retry calls.
Verify scoring pipeline is returning results; 0/0 checks suggests the voucher may not have been recognized or the scoring harness had an issue — check voucher ID 608978806 manually.
Confirm account 6540 (Inventar) is the correct account for office chairs vs. 6500-series operating expense accounts, as 'Kontorstoler' may map better to 6560 or similar.
